item.title: Darderi wins Santiago title, continuing clay dominance
item.description: Luciano Darderi won his fifth ATP Tour title Sunday with a battling victory in the BCI Seguros Chile Open final. Two weeks after falling short in the Buenos Aires final, the Argentine-born Italian defeated Yannick Hanfmann 7-6(6), 7-5 to claim the trophy on the red clay of the Santiago ATP 250. Now 5-1 in ATP Tour finals, all on clay and all since 2024, Darderi owns the most tour-level clay titles of any player since the start of the 2024 season — breaking a tie with Carlos Alcaraz. item.title: From Courier to Federer & Djokovic, reliving ATP No. 1 Club Sunshine Double sweeps
item.description: From the dry desert conditions of Indian Wells to the sticky humidity of Miami, the Sunshine Double is a challenge that few have managed to conquer with both trophies in tow.
